# OTLP test fixture

Unmodified official trace Protobuf definitions from `open-telemetry/opentelemetry-proto@v1.11.1`, Apache-2.0 (copyright/license headers retained). Tests use protobufjs to decode the real OTLP/Protobuf wire payload, not a production test hook or hand-written decoder.

Source: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-proto/tree/v1.11.1/opentelemetry/proto
